info.title: EasyHostAgent HTTP API
info.description: Agent-side contract for EasyTier↔EasyHostAgent. Controller-side browser API is NOT defined here. Docker/Compose only in v1; passive calls, no heartbeat, no remote Git, no automatic rollback.

agentAddress.description: Address chosen from verified EasyTier device IP after explicit user request

tags.name: Agent
tags.description: On-demand control plane. Never call periodically as a heartbeat.

get.summary: Check whether the Agent API process is reachable
Read unauthenticated Agent identity for explicit trust bootstrap

200.description: Identity; MUST verify SPKI fingerprint out of band before pairing

post.summary: Exchange local one-time pairing code for a controller-specific token
post.description: Requires verified TLS pin established out-of-band first. One-time code expires within 10 minutes, limited attempts, one use. Successful new pairing invalidates prior bearer grants; re-pair authorization must be enabled locally while already bound.

delete.description: Best effort while online. The controller must immediately discard its credential on local unbind. If host offline, host-side revocation cannot be asserted until local administrative reset or a successful new pairing.

get.summary: Query host resources and Docker availability on demand

patch.summary: Change SOFTWARE_ROOT only when no managed applications exist
patch.description: Canonicalize path and reject symlinks/path escapes and updates when managed apps exist; never move data automatically.

get.summary: Enumerate all Docker resources including stopped containers
get.description: When the Docker query fails, return complete=false, status=error and zero new authoritative deletions; do not silently return an empty successful inventory.

200.description: Docker inventory (can be incomplete, never delete on incomplete)

get.summary: Read logs for a known Docker resource

head.summary: Check whether immutable deployment bundle is present

put.summary: Upload immutable Deploy artifact received from EasyTier
put.description: Max 64 MiB, streaming bounded verification; reject archive traversal, symlinks, special device entries and unsupported file types. Bundle is not executed upon upload; allowlisted task actions only. Identical digest PUT is idempotent.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: Expected lower-case SHA-256 of exact bytes

post.description: Persist before returning HTTP 202. Same task_id with same canonical request digest returns existing task without executing twice; conflicting digest gets HTTP 409. All operations, including start/stop/restart and host upgrades, use tasks. No rollback and no offline queue.

202.description: Task durably accepted or duplicate returned

get.summary: List persisted tasks for page reopen
Read durable task state on demand
Fetch incremental UTF-8 log chunk by byte offset
get.description: Offset is an agent-generated byte cursor and is monotonic. Secrets and pairing tokens must be redacted. This API has no streaming/WebSocket requirement.

200.description: At most 256 KiB of new text

post.summary: Request safe task cancellation without rollback
post.description: Cancellation is best effort at safe checkpoints, not destructive cleanup. Mark final cancelled/failed on result; preserve generated resources and logs.

202.description: Cancellation requested or terminal task unchanged

BearerAuth.description: High-entropy per-controller token returned exactly once by pairing. EasyTier stores encrypted; not JWT, not user session token.

message.description: Safe user-readable error; never includes secret values.

agent_id.description: Stable random UUID generated at installation.

tls_spki_sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo. Must be verified out-of-band; identity response alone is untrusted.

controller_id.description: Stable UUID of EasyTier controller installation; not the user ID.

pairing_code.description: One-time code read from local Agent CLI; never logged.

access_token.description: High-entropy bearer token shown once, stored encrypted by EasyTier; do not log.

software_root.description: Absolute path configured for managed apps.
Canonical absolute installation root. Reject while managed applications exist.

host_ip.description: Published host IP; empty means wildcard.

resource_id.description: Opaque stable per Docker scan resource identifier; use unchanged in subsequent API requests.

complete.description: Only true when Docker enumerated all resources successfully. NEVER infer deletions from incomplete=false.

text.description: Bounded log text; UTF-8 best effort.

task_id.description: Client-generated UUID; key for idempotency and unknown submission recovery.

action.description: Allowlisted operation. Not an arbitrary shell command.

application_id.description: Deploy catalog app ID when kind=application.

resource_id.description: Opaque Docker resource ID when targeting discovered external resource.

catalog_revision.description: Central Deploy source commit/revision, for audit only.

variant.description: Manifest-declared runtime variant; first phase docker/compose.

parameters.description: Manifest-declared parameters only; reject unknown fields.

secrets.description: Manifest-declared sensitive parameters; encrypted at rest and removed from all responses/logs.

TaskStart.description: For install/update/configure/adopt, application bundle and manifest validation apply. For uninstall, retain_data defaults true. No automatic rollback.

TaskOptions.description: Destructive data removal requires retain_data=false AND confirm_delete_data=true. If existing historical data is detected, caller must make an explicit reuse choice.

status.description: Agent-local durable task state. outcome_unknown is controller-only when an HTTP submission response is lost.

text.description: UTF-8 decoded text chunk with no secrets.

Error403.description: Not authorized for this bound controller/device

Error409.description: Conflict, task ID collision or illegal state

Error422.description: Validated but unsupported input, host or operation

x-eha-contract-notes.transport: HTTPS mandatory. Pin SPKI SHA256 against locally shown fingerprint before any unauthenticated pairing. Do not disable verification, redirect or use ambient proxy; verify stable agent_id in response/header for authenticated requests.
x-eha-contract-notes.binding: EasyTier browser calls EasyTier Rust backend with existing user session. Only Rust backend calls this API. Client must send X-EHA-Controller-ID (controller UUID) and X-EHA-Agent-ID (expected UUID) for authenticated requests; agent validates token/controller/device binding. EasyTier validates returned agent_id, including after IP changes.
x-eha-contract-notes.behavior: HTTP tasks return immediately and persist locally; no automated task polling when page is closed, no lost-request auto retry without same task_id, no automatic cleanup/rollback after errors.
x-eha-contract-notes.inventory: complete=false or Docker provider error is never evidence of deleted applications. Stopped resources still exist.
x-eha-contract-notes.controller_reconciliation: EasyTier alone owns app templates, service creation/deletion, public mappings, store Git pull and authorization of admin vs own devices. Failure of service binding is stored as separately retryable state; never remove an otherwise successful Docker install.
x-eha-contract-notes.agent_restart: Previously running operations are recorded as interrupted/failed with logs retained; do not auto retry or rollback.
